description: Unit test class for FrameKeyboardViewClickListener, testing click handling for various UI elements in the quick text keys feature of the keyboard app.

classes.name: FrameKeyboardViewClickListenerTest
classes.description: Test class for FrameKeyboardViewClickListener, verifying click actions trigger correct keyboard responses and intents.

methods.name: testOnClickClose
methods.description: Tests that clicking the close button triggers the cancel key event.

methods.name: testOnClickBackSpace
methods.description: Tests that clicking the backspace button triggers the delete key event.

methods.name: testOnClickMedia
methods.description: Tests that clicking the media button triggers the image media popup key event.

methods.name: testOnClearEmoji
methods.description: Tests that clicking the clear emoji button triggers clearing quick text history and opening the quick text popup.

methods.name: testOnClickSetting
methods.description: Tests that clicking the settings button opens the quick text settings activity via intent.
